create_flux2_denoise_step: create a Flux2DenoiseStep block to iteratively denoise latents for Flux2 text-to-image generation
create_flux2_klein_denoise_step: create a Flux2KleinDenoiseStep block to iteratively denoise latents for Flux2-Klein text-to-image generation
create_flux2_klein_base_denoise_step: create a Flux2KleinBaseDenoiseStep block with CFG guidance for Flux2-Klein base model denoising
run_flux2_loop_denoiser: run Flux2LoopDenoiser to denoise latents using the Flux2Transformer2DModel with guidance scale
run_flux2_loop_after_denoiser: run Flux2LoopAfterDenoiser to update latents after denoising using FlowMatchEulerDiscreteScheduler
